cues: Electrophilic substitution has its own intermediate, this time with a positive charge.
When the electrophile attacks para to chlorine, that positive charge can land on the carbon holding chlorine, and chlorine's lone pair shares itself to form a C double bond C l plus structure.
That extra resonance form stabilises the intermediate.
The same is true for ortho attack.
